purpose: Accelerate the clean cross-circumference support gate without waiting for future race days by using archived race-date-specific PRE tables, while keeping target RESULT closed and preserving all contamination, identity and fail-closed rules.

date_window.why: The refreshed conservative burned firewall ends at 2026-08-25. The window ends before the already separately managed 2026-09-03 prospective population.

venue_pool.rule: Venue circumference must be verified by accepted Reality knowledge before support is counted.

population_selection_rule: Use whole-day Day1 blocks only, in chronological date order, from the frozen date window and venue pool.
A block enters acquisition only when an exact KDreams archive day/list href is positively observed; never derive or guess a racedetail ID by pattern.
For each accepted day block, acquire every race in that Day1 block. Do not cherry-pick races or riders based on any target outcome, odds, forecast, support overlap or apparent model value.
Freeze extracted PRE membership and content hashes before official identity resolution for support counting.
The entire eligible window is the intended acquisition pool; do not stop early because the first 30 riders look favorable.
primary_historical_pre_source: KDreams archived racecard/racedetail pages reached from positively observed archive hrefs

transport_validation.point_in_time_signal: Same-rider archived competition_score changed across historical race dates; validation example Kitamura Atsushi 77.95 on 2026-07-31, 77.29 on 2026-08-25/26 surfaces, 76.70 on 2026-08-31.
transport_validation.operational_note: Current environment external raw HTML download path was not available during validation, so this prespec grants no support increment by itself. Acquisition must remain fail-closed until raw HTML can be quarantined and parsed by the existing PRE-only parser without exposing target results.

raw_html_policy: Mixed-content source HTML is quarantine transport only, not model evidence.
Do not commit mixed raw HTML to the research evidence tree.
Run tools/keirin_kdreams_pre_only_parser_v1.py and commit only the allowlisted PRE table plus parser/source-hash receipt.
Any parser rejection, missing competition_score, zero competition_score, ambiguous metadata or missing tactical counts makes that race fail closed.
identity_policy: Map historical PRE rider names to official KEIRIN.JP registration numbers under KEIRIN_RIDER_IDENTITY_PRE_ONLY_MAPPING_CONTRACT_20260902_v1.json.
Current profile attributes are never backfilled historically.
Ambiguous, multiple, renamed or contradictory identity fails closed for rider-specific support.
Support is counted only from official_registration_number x valid PRE race rows.

result_policy.next_gate: Only if the clean PRE-only support gate passes, freeze the exact low-DOF Rider x Circumference formula, unsupported-rider policy, exact development membership, metric, race-cluster bootstrap and advance criterion before any target RESULT join.
